changes: Implemented the parent roadmap intent-totality gate: ledger/row evaluator, full-roadmap claim consumer, parent_roadmap_status and parent_roadmap_evaluate CLI surfaces, ProofStory inventory binding, process-fact registration, command policy coverage, and review-found blocker fixes for contradictory wording, enforce exit codes, shrunken inventories, missing closure evidence, and external proofstoryContract inventory.
usage: Use node packages/main/dist/cli.js parent_roadmap_status with a sample case or parent_roadmap_evaluate with a ledger plus optional proofstoryContract and summaryText. Full-roadmap wording is allowed only when all required rows are closed; partial, invalid, stale, blocked, missing, or migration rows return no-full-roadmap-claim with next actions.
expectedOutcome: A parent or handoff summary cannot claim an entire roadmap is done when required child rows remain open, missing, stale, invalid, blocked, or only parent-governed. Parent governance can be marked complete while the larger roadmap remains explicitly partial.
actualTranscript: Build passed; parent-roadmap totality smoke passed; ProofStory intent hardening smoke passed; process-fact contract verified; lattice validate passed 31 configured commands with 24/24 verification-intent coverage; DONE-required validation passed build plus root test suite; delivery review signed 4 docs promises and 5 real-machine tests; local 3x2 quorum passed with codex-cli and agy-cli over three rounds.
outcomeDiff: Matches expected behavior. Manual CLI probes showed partial ledgers reject full-roadmap wording and external ProofStory inventory forces missing required rows into the consumed rollup instead of allowing a shrunken full-complete claim.
limitations: Local CLI assurance only. This story implements the parent totality gate and claim boundary; it does not complete the remaining child implementation rows from the larger strengthening roadmap.
pitfalls: Do not treat parent-governed, child-story-needed, deferred-without-evidence, missing-required-row, stale, or invalid rows as full roadmap closure. Keep external proofstoryContract milestoneIds bound into the rollup so a narrowed ledger cannot become a false full-complete claim.
